dialogue.conversations.cat.chitchat.moon: Do you ever watch the moon?
dialogue.retune.moon.night/1: Most nights, aye. It is up there whether anyone looks or not, which I find restful.
dialogue.retune.moon.night/2: I do. It is the one thing in this village that never asks me for anything.
dialogue.retune.moon.night/3: When the work is done and the door is shut, yes. It is good company for a quiet hour.
dialogue.retune.moon.day/1: Not at this hour, but yes, when it is up. It is a steadier thing to look at than most.
dialogue.retune.moon.day/2: I do, when there is a night worth standing outside for. It never seems to be in a hurry.
dialogue.retune.moon.day/3: Now and then. It is up there whether anyone looks or not, and I find that restful.
dialogue.retune.moon.respond.agree: I watch it most nights myself.
dialogue.retune.moon.respond.ask_stories: Are there old stories about it here?
dialogue.retune.moon.respond.leave: I will let you get on.
dialogue.retune.moon.agree/1: Then you know. Half the village has never once looked up on purpose.
dialogue.retune.moon.agree/2: Good. It is better watched with somebody who is not talking through it.
dialogue.retune.moon.agree/3: I thought you might. You have the look of somebody who keeps late hours.
dialogue.retune.moon.stories/1: A few. Mostly warnings, which is what old stories usually turn out to be.
dialogue.retune.moon.stories/2: One or two the elders tell badly. They all end with somebody wishing they had gone home earlier.
dialogue.retune.moon.stories/3: There are. Nobody agrees on any of them, which I take as a good sign for a story.
dialogue.retune.moon.leave/1: Go on, then. It will be there tomorrow.
dialogue.retune.moon.leave/2: Right you are. Mind the road.
dialogue.retune.moon.plain/1: It is up there most nights. That is about all I have to say on it.
dialogue.retune.moon.plain/2: The moon does what the moon does. I have work in front of me.
dialogue.retune.moon.plain/3: Aye, it is a fine one tonight, or it will be.
